title: Structured logging with request ids
description: Logs were plain text and impossible to follow across services.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Switched to JSON logs with a request id on every line, so one customer request can be followed across services.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Gotcha: personal data was ending up in logs. A redaction step now removes emails and tokens before logs are written.
